title: sieve: RFC 5233 subaddress extension
description: Implement RFC 5233 subaddress extension in crates/sieve/src/extensions/subaddress.rs. Activated by require 'subaddress'. Adds :user and :detail address-parts to the address test (complement to existing :localpart, :domain, :all). Given an address user+detail@example.org with separator '+': :user extracts 'user' (localpart before separator), :detail extracts 'detail' (localpart after separator). Separator is configurable; default is '+'. If no separator present in localpart, :user = full localpart, :detail = empty string. Extend AddressPart enum with User and Detail variants. Extend address test evaluation to split localpart on separator when :user or :detail is selected. Tests: :user matches base, :detail matches subaddress, no-separator address gives empty :detail, separator configurable. Oracle: RFC 5233 §3 examples.
